workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The accepted image series creates dependent image roles that need stewardship, readiness, and checkpoint support.
reroute_triggers: Artist reduces scope to one compact artifact, or durable canon needs upgrade the project to full long-form.

story_structure.name: Problem / Reframe / Return
story_structure.core_movement: A felt problem is established, reframed through pressure at the threshold, then returned as residue rather than solved.
story_structure.adaptation_summary: The three-image series moves from empty invitation, to paralyzed nearness, to unresolved afterpressure.
story_structure.turn_logic: The sequence turns when the apparent invitation becomes an emotionally costly threshold instead of a route to closure.
story_structure.compression_rule: Use exactly three image roles for the fixture: absence, threshold, residue.
story_structure.expansion_rule: If expanded later, add intermediate beats only when each new image changes the emotional claim.
failure_modes: the series becomes three poses of the same claim
the door opens and resolves the pressure
the final image explains the emotion instead of leaving residue
